Definition: of Hebrew origin (H8012); Salmon, an Israelite:--Salmon.
BiblicalUsage: Salmon is an Israelite, the father of Boaz. You find the name in Matthew 1:4, "And Aram begat Aminadab; and Aminadab begat Naasson…", and again in Matthew 1:5.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Salmon matters because God names his people one by one, and none of them is forgotten. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
